why: Both analyses land on the same reliability-not-hand-wiring hedgehog and cover every key stop-doing item and brutal fact, with Analysis 2 slightly closer on the hedgehog because it adds a unit cost gap metric against imports and a manufacturing-automation seat. Analysis 1 reads the decline position more accurately (Stage 1 present, Stage 2 emerging, external blame and a sudden offshore move as later signs) and gives a tighter one-screen verdict, so it is marginally the better document to hand to the leader.
